caption: The drawing shows a toy composed of a small white horse with black spots that is wearing a blue blanket on its back, mounted on a four-wheeled carriage. The carriage frame is yellow with cutouts and has text on it which includes the words "POLICE" and "BELL". The wheels are metallic and have a spoked, intricate design. At the center of the carriage is a metallic, dome-shaped bell, with a metal handle attached beside it. The horse is positioned as if in motion and is attached in front of the bell on the carriage. The background is plain and uncolored, focusing attention on the toy.
title: Metal Toy: Trick Pony Bell Ringer
